question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘40 years with Abdul Kalam - Untold Stories’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sivathanu Pillai**__.

__
 
• **Sivathanu Pillai is the author of the book ‘40 years with Abdul Kalam - Untold Stories’.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A. Sivathanu Pillai** is Known as the **Father of Brahmos Aerospace**.
 
• He is an **Honorary Distinguished Professor** at Indian Space Research Organisation.
 
• He is the author of the book **40 years with Abdul Kalam - Untold Stories.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1e8bc554336c7866820fcb3e3225be3a4b7647dc4537f21dffa1d8ed70295a0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc78ef48a646632c929439d2c833c3d79458f58c39b6dd8427d1deddac8582a7.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Books written by **Y. S. Rajan** are **India 2020,** **The Scientific Indian and Way Beyond the Three Rs.**
 
• Books written by Chetan Bhagat are **Five Point Someone, One Night @ the Call Center, The 3 Mistakes Of My Life and Half Girlfriend.**
